name: Lions Guard LPC
desc:
The Sindrian Diktat’s elite receives the cream of the crop in fighter craft.  Many Lion’s Guard LPCs are modified with post-production flux management upgrades and fighter-grade solar shielding to the finished airframe, resulting in 10% improvements to flux stats and a 20% reduction to energy weapon damage.

While pushing the fighter’s flux core to their limits does provide a small and exploitable edge to the pilots, the solar shielding is the feature most appreciated by Lion’s Guard airmen (and the most coveted by Diktat regulars), as it affords protection to their craft against the dangers of both energy-based PD and the inner askonia system alike.  Studies suggest this is a major reason that Guardsmen pilots survive their tours of duty at a far higher rate than their regular military counterparts, and retire from service with fewer health defects.
short: Improves flux stats by 10%, energy weapon resistance by 20%

name: XIV Battlegroup LPC
desc: The Fourteenth Battlegroup, like many other notable units, received customized LPCs suited to their needs. The energy management system is replaced by late Domain-era versions to support armament upgrades, increasing flux dissipation and capacity by 20% over standard models.
short: Increases armor by 50, flux stats by 20%, reduces speed and maneuverability by 10%
